description: This PHP class 'HelpTopicDiscovery' is part of Drupal's help module, responsible for discovering help topic plugins from Twig files within specified directories. It implements plugin discovery, caching, and front matter parsing to generate plugin definitions.

classes.name: HelpTopicDiscovery
classes.description: A class that discovers help topic plugins from Twig files in specified directories, utilizing front matter parsing and caching mechanisms.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Returns flattened plugin definitions discovered from Twig files.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Discovers all help topic plugins, utilizing cache and parsing front matter in Twig files.

methods.name: findFiles
methods.description: Finds all Twig files in configured directories matching the pattern.
